claim_reviews.conclusion: Correct and ordinary for “local,” especially in institutional or geographically defined contexts.
claim_reviews.subject: Malaysian answer tempatan

claim_reviews.conclusion: “From the nearby area” is a valid narrowing of local, though it emphasizes origin/residence more than some uses of lokal or tempatan.

claim_reviews.conclusion: The different-common-word relation is materially misleading because setempat is also a standard local-area term in Malaysian Malay and Indonesian; no false-friend contrast is supported.

response.rationale: Both answers are valid for the cue, but the different-common-word relation overstates the contrast: Malaysian Malay also uses setempat for local, and Indonesian has setempat as a local-area term. No false-friend contrast is established.
